title: The Door in the Air
text: A door stands in empty space, frame and all, hanging over the dark with no wall to hold it. It is painted green and has a brass knocker. Through the keyhole, sunlight, warm and golden, and the sound of bees.

outcomes.text: Sunlight, warm and real, and bees, for one long moment. Then it is gone, and you have it still.
Not sunlight. Something on the other side was making the sound of bees.

options.label: The sharpest eye looks through the keyhole.

outcomes.text: Home, small and bright and far away. And the way back to it.
As you go, someone on the other side knocks, politely, three times.
